params.name: database
params.description: KEGG database name. Valid values include: kegg, pathway, brite, module, ko, genes, genome, ligand, compound, glycan, reaction, rclass, enzyme, network, variant, disease, drug, dgroup, and any organism code (e.g., hsa, eco).

items.docs: Display release information and statistics for a KEGG database, including the number of entries and linked databases.
